sectors.trend: Divergent: iron ore weakness pressures BHP and FMG, but copper surge and gold strength support diversified miners. Multiple gold discoveries (Forrestania, Kaiser, Larvotto, Aureka) signal sector rotation into precious metals.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX faces margin pressure from iron ore decline; gold names (GOLD.AX, NLA.AX, S32.AX) and copper exposure (BHP.AX, STO.AX) benefit. Aureka (ARK.AX) $8.9M acquisition signals small-cap consolidation.

sectors.trend: Hormuz Strait escalation drives oil price spike; Santos gas cartel break-through reshapes domestic gas pricing. Energy stocks lead ASX gains.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX), Woodside (WDS.AX), and Oil Search (OSG.AX) benefit from oil premium. Domestic gas price reform may pressure Santos margins long-term but improve consumer affordability.

sectors.trend: Housing price acceleration in falls and building company collapse raise NPL concerns. RBA unlikely to cut aggressively to save property. Super policy debate adds political overhang.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face rising credit risk from property and construction. Private credit exposure (headline 12) a key watch item. Super policy uncertainty affects fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX).

sectors.trend: Housing price falls accelerate dramatically; property industry described as facing 'GFC moment'. Parramatta Metro $880m development offers selective upside.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX, ICQ.AX) under pressure from falling valuations and rising vacancies. Residential builders (WBC.AX, GPT.AX) face demand destruction. Selective infrastructure-linked REITs may hold up.

sectors.trend: Living standards collapse: mortgage costs forcing second jobs, Australians feel poorer. Tobacco tax fight signals political pressure on consumer spending. Car supply crunch raises insurance premiums.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX, CSG.AX benefit from defensive rotation. Higher insurance premiums pressure CAR.AX, QLR.AX. Tobacco tax debate affects BAT.LN exposure via Australian distributors.

sectors.trend: $40b NT data centre land grant signals infrastructure buildout. AI boom continues but Taiwan strike threat (Micron) introduces supply chain risk. $445m crypto hack raises cybersecurity concerns.
sectors.implications: Data centre REITs and infrastructure plays benefit. ASX tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) face global AI volatility. Crypto exposure (CCL.AX, NGS.AX) hit by hack news.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market deterioration and credit contagion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to property REITs and residential builders; favour banks with lower residential mortgage concentration (CBA.AX over ANZ.AX). Monitor NPL trends.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Hormuz Strait escalation / oil supply shock
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure via WDS.AX, OSG.AX. Monitor AUD/USD as oil spike pressures terms of trade. Diversify away from oil-import-dependent sectors.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price decline pressuring BHP/FMG
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX and FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and copper-exposed miners. Monitor Chinese property stimulus signals.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Living standards collapse / consumer demand erosion
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour defensive consumer staples (WES.AX, WOW.AX, CSG.AX). Avoid discretionary consumer exposure. Watch retail sales data.
Monitor policy announcements; super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX, QAN.AX) may see volatility. Avoid over-concentration in single policy outcome.
Diversify tech exposure; monitor semiconductor supply chains. ASX tech names face global beta risk.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to slightly lower. Energy and gold miners provide support, but housing stress, iron ore weakness, and geopolitical risk cap upside. RBA unlikely to cut aggressively. Expect volatility around Hormuz developments and super policy announcements.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from housing correction, living standards squeeze, and iron ore demand softening. Gold, energy transition, and data centre capex offer growth pockets. Property sector may take 12-18 months to stabilise. RBA policy constrained by fiscal pressures.
